typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		employee_id as string,
		employee_name as string,
		department as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> Input1	source(output(
		lkp_employee_id as string,
		lkp_employee_name as string,
		status as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> Input2
Input1 sort(asc(employee_id, false)) ~> Sort
Input2 sort(asc(lkp_employee_id, false)) ~> Sort1
Sort,Sort1 join(employee_id == lkp_employee_id,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin derive(employee_id = employee_id,
		lkp_employee_id = lkp_employee_id,
		employee_name = employee_name,
		department = department,
		status = status) ~> MergeJoin0
MergeJoin0 sink(input(
		lkp_employee_id as string,
		employee_id as string,
		employee_name as string,
		department as string,
		status as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		lkp_employee_id,
		employee_id,
		employee_name,
		department,
		status)) ~> FlatFileDestination
